_meta.note: Markets listed explicitly; default `newBraunfels` (25/75) sets the app's payer mix. Forney kept for alternate market toggle.

newBraunfels.note: Comal Co., 18% age 65+ → 25% govt payer share (app default)

forney.note: Kaufman Co., 11% age 65+ → 15% govt payer share

newBraunfels_base.note: Base scenario, targeted commercial 75% × net realization 0.94 → steady-state $/proc

newBraunfels_conservative.note: Conservative scenario, targeted commercial 65% × net realization 0.83

newBraunfels_aggressive.note: Aggressive scenario, targeted commercial 85% × net realization 0.96

forney_legacy_pre_realization.note: Pre-v12 calculation: 15% gov / 85% commercial × 1.496 mult × $1,408 base. No net realization factor applied.

cpt_weighted_base.note: SUMPRODUCT of 4 CPT codes (36482, 36465, 36466, 36475) × volume shares

max_capacity_peak.note: Peak physician ceiling. Y1 steady-state is lower (see net_capacity_base × utilization_ramp).

net_capacity_base.note: Path B: 18 days × 8 procs/day × 0.90 no-show × 0.95 cancel = 123/mo net capacity. Was 108 pre-Path-B.

utilization_ramp_base.note: Fraction of net capacity utilized by year, Base scenario.

net_realization_factor.note: Path B: collections net of denials/write-offs. Conservative reflects denial pressure; Base matures via RCM; Aggressive top-quartile RCM.

targeted_commercial_share.note: Operator-controlled payer mix via channel strategy.

contact_rate.note: v12: composite from Lead Source Mix, Σ (volumeShare × contactRate)

effective_procs_per_patient.note: v12: derived = expectedPathwayProcs × pathwayCompletion. Isolated downside: Conservative = Base.

expected_pathway_procs.note: v12 hardening: weighted mean from COMPLEXITY_DISTRIBUTION (pctLow × meanLow + pctMid × meanMid + pctHigh × meanHigh).

pathway_completion.note: v12: % of treated patients completing the full plan. Isolated downside: Conservative = Base.

lead_source_mix_composite_contact_rate.note: v12: Paid Search / Meta / SEO / Referral / Repeat weighted composite.

y2_growth.note: AUDIT 2026-04-23 C-4 resolved: now wired as marketing-spend scalar in adjustAssumptionsForYear.

sclero_mix.note: Retired from active mix, superseded by Varithena CPTs.

varithena_cost_per_proc.note: = F47 + $150 drug. F47 includes waste factor from spreadsheet.

venaseal_kit_unit_cost.note: AUDIT 2026-04-23 C-5 resolved: prior value 0.4 was a lookup artifact, not the kit price.

billing_pct_of_revenue.note: AUDIT 2026-04-23 S-3 resolved: surfaced from magic-number; now editable via Assumptions.
